entities.summary: Neeru Chadha is an Indian jurist who serves as a member of the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea (ITLOS). She previously served in the Indian government's external affairs ministry as an additional secretary and legal adviser, heading its legal and treaties division, among other positions.
